add-footer-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Footer Watermark to PDF Pages
add-footer-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through each page, and adding a WatermarkAnnotation at the bottom as a unique page identifier, then saving the result.

embed-pdf-portfolio-rich-media-disable-p.title: Embed PDF Portfolio as Rich Media and Disable Printing
embed-pdf-portfolio-rich-media-disable-p.description: Shows how to embed a PDF portfolio into a PDF using a RichMediaAnnotation and then prevent printing by applying encryption with specific permissions.

add-screen-annotation-external-video.title: Add Screen Annotation with External Video URL
add-screen-annotation-external-video.description: Demonstrates how to add a ScreenAnnotation to a PDF page that references an external video URL and starts playback automatically.

increase-sound-annotation-clickable-area.title: Increase Clickable Area of Sound Annotations by 20%
increase-sound-annotation-clickable-area.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate all SoundAnnotation objects, enlarge their rectangle by 20% while keeping the center point, and save the modified document.

apply-tiled-pdf-pattern-watermark.title: Apply Tiled PDF Pattern as Watermark Across All Pages
apply-tiled-pdf-pattern-watermark.description: Demonstrates using WatermarkArtifact with SetPdfPage to tile a PDF page as a background watermark on every page of a target PDF document.

add-javascript-link-annotation.title: Add JavaScript Link Annotation to Open URL
add-javascript-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a link annotation with a JavaScript action that opens a URL in a new browser window using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-watermark-annotations-with-logo.title: Batch Replace Watermark Annotations with a Logo Image
replace-watermark-annotations-with-logo.description: Shows how to iterate through all PDF pages, locate existing WatermarkAnnotation objects, keep their opacity and rectangle, delete them, and add a new StampAnnotation that displays a corporate logo image.

add-3d-annotation-with-custom-camera.title: Add 3D Annotation with Custom Camera to PDF
add-3d-annotation-with-custom-camera.description: Shows how to embed a 3D model into a PDF and define a custom camera view using Aspose.Pdf 3D annotation classes.

fade-background-artifacts.title: Fade PDF Background Artifacts by Setting Opacity
fade-background-artifacts.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages, locate BackgroundArtifact objects, and set their opacity to 40% to create a faded background effect.

add-rich-media-video-annotation.title: Add Rich Media Video Annotation with Poster to PDF
add-rich-media-video-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to embed an MP4 video and a poster image into a PDF using a RichMediaAnnotation.

add-sound-annotation-voiceover-page-five.title: Add Sound Annotation for Voice‑over on PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-voiceover-page-five.description: Demonstrates how to add a SoundAnnotation that plays a voice‑over WAV file when the user clicks a defined region on page five of a PDF document.

add-qr-code-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add QR Code Watermark to PDF
add-qr-code-watermark-to-pdf.description: Creates a PDF document and adds a QR code image as a watermark artifact positioned at the top‑right corner of the page.

create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.title: Create Button to Toggle Annotations Visibility
create-button-toggle-annotations-visibil.description: Shows how to add a push‑button form field to a PDF page and assign JavaScript that toggles the hidden state of all annotations on that page.

batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Add Sound Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-sound-annotations-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add a SoundAnnotation to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, assigning a different audio file to each page.

extract-media-from-screenannotation.title: Extract Media Files from ScreenAnnotations in a PDF
extract-media-from-screenannotation.description: Demonstrates how to locate ScreenAnnotation objects in a PDF, retrieve the associated media via a GoToRemoteAction, and save the embedded file to disk for further analysis.

add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.title: Add Read‑Only Rich Media PDF Annotation
add-read-only-rich-media-pdf-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF as a rich‑media annotation in another PDF and set it to read‑only using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: Export PDF Annotations to CSV
export-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Opens a PDF document, iterates through each page and its annotations, and writes key annotation details (type, name, title, contents, rectangle) to a CSV file for auditing purposes.

add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.title: Create Button Annotation to Highlight Text Fields
add-button-annotation-highlight-text-fie.description: Shows how to add a push‑button annotation to a PDF page with Aspose.Pdf, attach a JavaScript action that highlights all text fields on the current page, and save the updated document.

add-highres-pdf-page-as-tiled-background.title: Add High-Resolution PDF Page as Tiled Background
add-highres-pdf-page-as-tiled-background.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's BackgroundArtifact to set a high‑resolution PDF page as a tiled background for a new document.

set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.title: Set Red Border and Width for Link Annotations
set-link-annotation-border-red-width-3.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages and link annotations, changes each link's border color to red and line width to three points, then saves the modified document.

add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.title: Add Repeating Text Watermark Artifact to PDF Pages
add-repeating-text-watermark-artifact.description: Demonstrates how to create a semi‑transparent WatermarkArtifact with repeating text and apply it as a background to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.title: Add Screen Annotation with External SWF and Disable Editing
add-screen-annotation-swf-readonly.description: Demonstrates how to add a ScreenAnnotation that references an external SWF file to a PDF page and make it read‑only to prevent user interaction.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import XFDF Annotations into PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, import matching XFDF annotation files into each PDF, and save the annotated documents. The example shows batch processing and error handling using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.title: Add Rich Media Video Annotation (Click Activation)
add-rich-media-video-annotation__v2.description: Demonstrates how to embed a video file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's RichMediaAnnotation, set the activation event, and save the modified document.

replace-pdf-page-background-images.title: Replace PDF Page Background Images
replace-pdf-page-background-images.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF pages, locate BackgroundArtifact objects, and replace their images with a new file while keeping the original positions unchanged.

metadata-watermark-annotation.title: Add Metadata-Based Watermark Annotation to PDF
metadata-watermark-annotation.description: The example opens a PDF, reads the document title (or a default), creates a WatermarkAnnotation with that text, configures its appearance, and saves the watermarked PDF.

add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.title: Add JavaScript Link Annotation to Show Modal Dialog
add-javascript-link-annotation-modal-dia.description: Shows how to create a link annotation with a JavaScript action that displays a custom modal dialog box in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.title: Batch Add WatermarkArtifact with Dynamic Opacity to PDFs
batch-watermark-dynamic-opacity.description: Processes all PDF files in a folder, adds a centered watermark artifact whose opacity is calculated from the document's page count, and saves the watermarked PDFs to an output folder.

create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.title: Create 3D Annotation with Metallic Lighting
create-3d-annotation-metallic-lighting.description: Demonstrates embedding a 3‑D model into a PDF and configuring lighting, render mode, and material properties to simulate realistic metal surfaces.

add-sound-annotation-chime.title: Add Sound Annotation (Chime) to PDF Page
add-sound-annotation-chime.description: Shows how to insert a SoundAnnotation that plays a chime when a specific page becomes visible in a PDF document.

clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.title: Clone RichMediaAnnotations to a Summary Page
clone-richmedia-annotations-summary-page.description: Loads a PDF, gathers all RichMediaAnnotation objects, adds a new summary page, and clones each annotation onto that page while preserving key properties.

create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.title: Create PDF Button to Export Annotations as JSON
create-pdf-button-export-annotations-jso.description: The example loads an existing PDF, adds a push‑button form field, and assigns a JavaScript action that gathers all annotations, converts them to a JSON string, and displays the result. The modified PDF is then saved with the new export button.

add-diagonal-watermark-annotation.title: Add Diagonal Watermark Annotation to PDF
add-diagonal-watermark-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to place a WatermarkAnnotation diagonally across a PDF page using a rectangle geometry and simulate a gradient effect with semi‑transparent color.

extract-embedded-rich-media.title: Extract Embedded Rich Media from PDF Annotations
extract-embedded-rich-media.description: Shows how to walk through PDF pages, locate RichMediaAnnotation objects, and save their embedded video/audio or binary content into a page‑based folder structure.

create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.title: Create Link Annotation to Open Remote PDF Page
create-link-annotation-remote-pdf-page.description: Shows how to add a link annotation that opens a specific page of an external PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.title: Add Animated GIF Screen Annotation to PDF Page
add-animated-gif-screen-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to place a ScreenAnnotation that shows an animated GIF, looping continuously, on the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.title: Align Watermark Annotations to Page Margins
align-watermark-annotations-to-page-marg.description: Shows how to adjust the rectangle of every WatermarkAnnotation in a PDF so that the watermarks line up uniformly with specified page margins.

toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.title: Toggle Rich Media Annotation Visibility with a Button
toggle-rich-media-annotation-visibility.description: Demonstrates how to add a RichMediaAnnotation to a PDF and use a push button with JavaScript to toggle its visibility at runtime.

add-3d-annotation-front-view.title: Add 3D Annotation with Front View to PDF
add-3d-annotation-front-view.description: Shows how to embed a U3D/PRC 3‑D model into a PDF, create a 3‑D annotation, define a front‑facing view, and save the updated document.

batch-replace-watermark-annotations.title: Batch Replace Watermark Annotations with Current Date
batch-replace-watermark-annotations.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through all pages and annotations, identify WatermarkAnnotation objects, and replace their text with a string that includes the current date.

add-word-count-link-annotation.title: Create PDF Link Annotation that Shows Word Count
add-word-count-link-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to add a clickable link annotation to a PDF that runs JavaScript to calculate the total word count of the document and displays it in an alert.

add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.title: Add Automatic Background Music to PDF
add-automatic-background-music-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed an MP3 audio file as a RichMediaAnnotation that automatically plays when the page becomes visible.

create-pdf-gradient-background-artifact.title: Create PDF with Gradient Background Artifact
create-pdf-gradient-background-artifact.description: Shows how to add a BackgroundArtifact to a PDF page and outlines the approach for using a form (XForm) to apply a gradient fill instead of a solid color.

add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.title: Add Dynamic Page Number Watermark to PDF
add-dynamic-page-number-watermark.description: Shows how to create a WatermarkAnnotation that displays the current page number on each page of a PDF and saves the result using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.title: Add Rich Media Annotation with PDF Portfolio
add-rich-media-annotation-pdf-portfolio.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF portfolio into a RichMedia annotation and set the initial view to the first embedded file using Aspose.Pdf.

change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.title: Change Button Annotation Color to Blue
change-button-annotation-color-to-blue.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all annotations, sets the color of button field annotations to blue, and saves the modified document.

batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.title: Batch Add Video Screen Annotations to PDF Pages
batch-add-video-screen-annotations__v2.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all pages of a PDF and add a ScreenAnnotation that plays a video, adjusting the annotation rectangle to keep the video’s aspect ratio.
